Name: Elisha
Summary: Elisha succeeded Elijah and performed twice as many miracles, showing God's compassion to widows, kings, and a foreign commander. His ministry spanned several kings of Israel.
KeyStory: Elisha received Elijah's mantle at the Jordan and healed Naaman the Syrian, who washed seven times and was cleansed of leprosy.
LifeLesson: Elisha asked for a double portion and then simply got to work serving people. Ask God boldly, then spend that blessing on compassion for those around you.
